title: Techno Kids Course | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Techno Kids Course. Category: Development. Duration: 1 month. Description: Covers Microsoft Paint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Urdu Typing, Google Forms, Canva basics, and Adobe Illustrator/Photoshop basics for kids. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
